class.name: Thunder Ronin Class
lore: Choose the Thunder Ronin Class
class.desc_es: Un samurái errante cargado de trueno: tajos que paralizan, desenvainados a la velocidad del rayo y una forma de Dios del Trueno.

skills.name: Lightning Reflex
lore: Dodge incoming attacks with a 22% chance. Gain a small burst of
speed after every successful dodge.
skills.desc_es: Pasiva: un 22 % de probabilidad de esquivar un ataque y ganar un acelerón.

skills.name: Thunder Slash
lore: Unleash a slash infused with thunder energy. Every third strike,
leap up and smash down, striking the surface with thunder with a
20% chance to paralyze hit enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Tajos cargados de trueno; cada tercer golpe saltas y caes con un rayo que puede paralizar.

skills.name: Thunderclap and Flash
lore: Unleash an ultra-high-speed dash and draw slash from your sheathed
sword. Delivers a devastating blow in a single instant before the
enemy can react.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Una embestida rapidísima desenvainando la espada: un golpe devastador antes de que el enemigo reaccione.

skills.name: Flamestorm Reversal
lore: Step back and slash twice in a wide arc, countering and paralyzing
enemies.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {skillcooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Das un paso atrás y lanzas dos tajos amplios que contraatacan y paralizan.

skills.name: Crackling Skyfall
lore: Leap into the air while gathering thunder energy, release a mid-air
plunge attack that crashes down like a lightning strike from the sky.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {skillcooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Saltas acumulando energía de trueno y caes en picado como un rayo.

skills.name: Thunderous Barrage
lore: Focus and pierce forward multiple times with very high speed.
During this time, your movement speed gets slowed.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Te concentras y lanzas muchas estocadas rapidísimas hacia delante, moviéndote más despacio mientras tanto.

skills.name: Flaming Thunder God
lore: Transform into a thunder god, with a thunder dragon summoned
behind you. Your skillset changes in this form:
Flaming Thunder Slash (LMB): Unleash a slash infused with flaming
thunder energy. Every third strike, leap up and smash down, striking
the surface with thunder with a 30% chance to paralyze hit enemies.
Every fourth strike, step back and execute a down-smash slash that
summons a series of lighting strikes.
Sixfold (RMB): Unleash 6 ultra-high-speed dashes, zigzagging
across enemies and slashing each of them, stunning them for a short
time. Delivers a devastating blow in a single instant before the
enemy can react.
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Te transformas en el Dios del Trueno con un dragón de trueno a tu espalda: tus ataques cambian y caen rayos con cada golpe.
